name: flixel-pixi
description: A TypeScript port of the original AS3 Flixel engine using PixiJS v8.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:workspaces && npm run build:types:root && npm run build:adapters && npm run build:lib:root && npm run build:smoke && npm run build:games && npm run build:apps && npm run report:bundle
scripts.build:types: npm run build:workspaces && npm run build:types:root && npm run build:adapters
scripts.build:lib: npm run build:workspaces && npm run build:types:root && npm run build:adapters && npm run build:lib:root
scripts.build:workspaces: npm run build --workspace @flixel-pixi/schemas && npm run build --workspace @flixel-pixi/particles && npm run build --workspace @flixel-pixi/editor-protocol
scripts.check:physics-adapter: npm run build:types:root && npm run build:adapters && node scripts/check-physics-adapter-package.mjs
scripts.check:physics-playground: npm run build:lib && npm run api:check && node scripts/check-physics-playground-package.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:workspaces
scripts.check:budgets: npm run build:lib && npm run report:bundle && npm run bench && node scripts/check-performance-budgets.mjs
scripts.check:package: npm run build:lib && npm run api:check && npm run check:package:contract && node scripts/check-package-artifact.mjs
scripts.verify:budgets: npm run check:budgets && npm run test:perf
scripts.docs:prepare: npm run build:games && npm run build:apps && node scripts/prepare-docs-assets.mjs
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:prepare && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:prepare && vitepress build docs
scripts.verify:quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:workspaces && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run api:check && node scripts/check-package-artifact.mjs && npm run check:physics-adapter && node scripts/check-physics-playground-package.mjs && npm run bench && npm run check:games-imports
scripts.verify: npm run verify:quality && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:matrix
